title: PORT-BRANCH-agent-harness-1: carry agent-harness-1 onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `agent-harness-1` at 7556227e5e holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: site/agentdata.js, site/agentic.js, site/controlplane.js, site/worker.js)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried agent-harness-1
**Status:** closed

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 8 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried agent-harness-1

**Evidence:** Superseded: main already has site/connectagent.js and the /connect-agent route (site/worker.js, site/agentic.js), A2A SendMessage/GetTask, submit_work and get_blind_spots in site/agentic.js, /api/v1/export and import in site/controlplane.js, and the ROADMAP-AGENT-* items in docs/issues.
